name: EBAD-NeRF
aliases: Event-driven Bundle Adjustment for Deblurring Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A framework that jointly optimizes learnable camera poses during exposure time and NeRF parameters to reconstruct sharp 3D representations from blurry images and event data, explicitly modeling motion blur via intensity-change-metric event loss and photo-metric blur loss.
summary: EBAD-NeRF reconstructs sharp 3D radiance fields from motion-blurred images by jointly optimizing learnable camera poses and NeRF parameters using hybrid event-RGB data.
